typography.label: text-sm font-medium text-slate-500 uppercase tracking-wider
typography.instructions: Import 'Manrope' from Google Fonts. Use it for all Headings (h1-h3). Use 'Inter' for body text, inputs, and tables.

primary.name: Postal Red
primary.usage: Primary Buttons, Critical Alerts, Branding Accents

secondary.name: Official Blue
secondary.usage: Sidebar, Active Navigation Items, Header Accents

success.name: Finance Green
success.usage: Positive Values, Paid Status, Trends Up

colors.contrast_rules: Always ensure text on colored backgrounds meets WCAG AA standards. Use white text on Primary and Secondary backgrounds.

buttons.primary: bg-red-700 hover:bg-red-800 text-white font-medium shadow-sm transition-all active:scale-95
buttons.secondary: bg-white border border-slate-300 text-slate-700 hover:bg-slate-50 shadow-sm transition-all

cards.default: bg-white border border-slate-200 shadow-sm rounded-lg p-6 hover:shadow-md transition-shadow
cards.metric: flex flex-col gap-2 p-6 bg-white rounded-lg border border-slate-100 shadow-[0_2px_10px_-3px_rgba(6,81,237,0.1)]

inputs.default: flex h-10 w-full rounded-md border border-slate-300 bg-white px-3 py-2 text-sm ring-offset-white file:border-0 file:bg-transparent file:text-sm file:font-medium placeholder:text-slate-400 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-blue-900 focus-visible:ring-offset-2 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-50

tables.header: bg-slate-50 text-slate-500 uppercase text-xs font-semibold tracking-wider

status_badges.active: inline-flex items-center rounded-full bg-emerald-50 px-2 py-1 text-xs font-medium text-emerald-700 ring-1 ring-inset ring-emerald-600/20
status_badges.pending: inline-flex items-center rounded-full bg-amber-50 px-2 py-1 text-xs font-medium text-amber-700 ring-1 ring-inset ring-amber-600/20
status_badges.overdue: inline-flex items-center rounded-full bg-red-50 px-2 py-1 text-xs font-medium text-red-700 ring-1 ring-inset ring-red-600/10
status_badges.inactive: inline-flex items-center rounded-full bg-slate-50 px-2 py-1 text-xs font-medium text-slate-600 ring-1 ring-inset ring-slate-500/10

patterns.login_bg: Use a subtle 'banknote' or 'guilloche' pattern SVG in the background with very low opacity (3-5%) on a slate-50 background.

accessibility.contrast_check: Ensure all text meets APCA/WCAG AA standards. No light grey text on white backgrounds.

charts.style: Minimalist. Remove grid lines where possible. Use simple tooltips.

login_hero.description: Professional accounting/finance scene, calculator, papers, clean desk
login_hero.usage: Login page side image or background overlay

empty_state.description: Clean, minimal illustration for empty states

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do NOT use 'Inter' for Headings. Use 'Manrope'.
Do NOT use generic purple/blue gradients. Use the specific Postal Red and Official Blue palette.
Do NOT use standard HTML tables. Use the styled Table component with 'striped' rows for readability.
Do NOT center-align dashboard text. Align numbers to the right, text to the left.
For the Sidebar, use a solid dark blue (#1E3A8A) background with white text.
Ensure the Dashboard is 'Dense' but 'Breathable'. Use the Bento Grid Mode B.
For 'Status' columns, always use the 'Badges' defined in components section.
Format currency as '₹ 1,200.00' (Indian Rupee with commas).
